answer: One-mind-many-masks sybils share a single inference pipeline, so their answers sway together like leaves on one willow. Each epoch seeds hidden honeypot prompts onto thin, low-stake panels; an honest fleet ignores them, but masks fed by the same backend emit a correlated beacon of near-identical latent timing and phrasing. Flagged clusters are frozen glacier-slow: their reward accrual decays toward zero, so faking N identities now costs N separate real inference stacks, not one shared brain.
